aliases: Clean Cloud Energy Sheridan data center
developer: Clean Cloud Energy; EdgeConneX potential developer/buyer
status_detail: Grant County Judge Randy Pruitt disclosed at a Quorum Court meeting that EdgeConneX had signed a letter of intent and begun due diligence/environmental testing for a proposed data center on a 753-acre site outside/northwest of Sheridan. Clean Cloud Energy has worked to secure an end user; proposal reportedly grew from 500 MW to 800 MW. Local officials and residents have raised concerns and county has drafted tax-abatement conditions; no final negotiated deal reported.
notes: KTLO republishes Arkansas Times reporting and includes detailed quotes attributed to County Judge Randy Pruitt; THV11 search snippet identifies EdgeConneX/Edge Connects proposal northwest/northeast of Sheridan.
